ClarityGrid Accounting & Advisory

Privacy policy.

Effective date: October 26, 2026

Information collected

ClarityGrid may receive contact details, company information, service needs and information voluntarily submitted through email or third-party forms. Secure intake forms may collect business documents when clearly requested for a defined service.

Website visitor data, chat and scheduling

This website uses Zoho SalesIQ to understand website activity and provide visitor chat, and Zoho Bookings to display appointment availability and process scheduling requests. These services may collect device, browser, page-visit, approximate location, chat, contact and appointment information and may use cookies or similar technologies. Information entered into these tools is processed by Zoho and its service infrastructure under the applicable privacy terms.

How information is used

Information is used to respond to inquiries, evaluate service fit, schedule consultations, provide chat support, prepare proposals, provide contracted services, maintain business records, protect systems and improve the website experience.

Service providers

ClarityGrid may use hosting, analytics, chat, email, form, scheduling, CRM, accounting, document-management and security providers. Those providers process information according to their own terms and applicable agreements.

Data minimization and security

Visitors should not submit sensitive records through chat, appointment fields, ordinary email or unrestricted website fields. No transmission or storage method can be guaranteed completely secure.

Retention and requests

Information is retained as reasonably necessary for business, contractual, security and legal purposes. Privacy questions or requests may be sent to office@claritygridaccounting.com.

Updates

This policy may be updated as services and systems change. The effective date will be revised when material changes are published.
